paragraphs.text:
The rage you feel has awakened something primitive in you, for 
you track as you never have before. You follow the trail until you 
see a soft glow breaking through the young trees ahead.

Your party crawls forward, rifles carried in the crooks of your 
arms, until you overlook the source of the glow.
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 203.
